prompt: Some people think the main benefit of international cooperation is in protection of the environment, while others think that the main benefit is in the world business. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
There is a debate over the primary advantage of international alliances, with some arguing that its greatest benefit is environmental protection, while others believe that its main contribution is to global commerce and economic growth. I agree with the latter view.

On the one hand, international environmental agreements have played an important role in protecting the planet. Such treaties can restrict activities that cause pollution or threaten wildlife and require participating nations to take measures to reduce their environmental impact. Consequently, governments have an incentive to fulfil their obligations and avoid legal or diplomatic consequences. For example, the MARPOL Convention establishes international rules to prevent ships from discharging oil and other harmful substances into the sea, helping to reduce marine pollution and protect marine ecosystems. Nevertheless, I believe that the economic benefits of international collaboration are more significant.

On the other hand, global collaboration has a broader effect on trade and national economies. International agreements allow nations to exchange natural resources, goods and services across borders, enabling businesses to access larger markets and governments to generate revenue through exports. This foreign income can contribute to economic growth and create employment opportunities. For instance, Saudi Arabia exports petroleum to countries worldwide, generating substantial foreign revenue that supports its economic development. International trade also allows countries to obtain products and services that cannot be produced domestically on the same scale.

In conclusion, although international cooperation has helped protect the environment through treaties regulating pollution and wildlife, I believe its contribution to global business and economic development is more substantial because it creates broader economic opportunities and generates revenue for participating nations.
